about: d1 of the planted method in method.json, computed outside the repo before any digest code existed: annotations (title, description, examples, $comment) dropped in schema positions, every #/$defs $ref replaced by its definition and $defs dropped, then RFC 8785 bytes (the Python encoder that made rfc8785-kernel.json) and SHA-256. method-defs.json (mode moved into $defs) and method-reordered.json (keys reordered) give the same digest; the SHA-256 of each file's own bytes differs from it.
